- [GK-BPHS36] Gajakesari, strict: Jupiter in a kendra from the lagna or the Moon, joined or aspected by a benefic, not debilitated, combust or in an enemy's sign: does not hold. kendra from lagna no, from Moon yes; benefic contact Mo; debilitated no; enemy's sign yes; combust no. Source: BPHS 36.3-4, source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked. Base rate 9%.
- [KESARI-LOOSE] Kesari (loose 'Gajakesari'): Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon: HOLDS. Jupiter M7. Source: Phaladeepika VI.14 per the BPHS translator (only 'Kesari'); called Gajakesari by CRUX p28-30 and HJH1 p118 - source map BPHS_part3.md, not page-checked. Base rate 34%.
- [KEM-BARE] Kemadruma (Varahamihira): no planet other than the Sun (nodes not counted) in the 2nd or 12th from the Moon: does not hold. 2nd/12th from the Moon: Sa. Source: Brihat Jataka XIII (p175-178), source map BJ.md, not page-checked; Varahamihira rejects the other schools' versions. Base rate 45%.
- [KEM-BPHS] Kemadruma (BPHS 37.11-13): besides the 2nd/12th, no planet but the Sun with the Moon or in a kendra from the lagna - the Moon itself in a kendra counts (LOL p322; Garga/Parasara via BJ): does not hold. 2nd/12th occupied. Source: BPHS p398 (ch. 37 sl. 11-13), source map BPHS_part3.md §5 (BPHS ch. 34-38), not page-checked. Base rate 3%.
